questions.question: Which of the following best expresses the main idea of a passage discussing AI in enterprise automation?
options: AI replaces human labor entirely in modern tech companies.
AI enhances efficiency by augmenting human capabilities in routine tasks.
Enterprise automation is too expensive for modern startups.
Data privacy regulations prevent AI adoption.
questions.correctAnswer: AI enhances efficiency by augmenting human capabilities in routine tasks.
questions.explanation: Standard reading comprehension passages focus on balanced augmentation rather than total replacement.
